verdict.rationale: Postman's Agent Mode lets users act on their API data using natural language (send requests, fix errors, update tests) via AI, which is a form of AI-generated insight/suggestion inside the product, and MCP Generator/gateway features extend AI access to Postman data. However, evidence is limited to first-party docs describing capabilities generically, with no concrete examples of proactive insights/analytics-driven suggestions (e.g., anomaly detection, performance insights) and no independent/hands-on corroboration of Agent Mode's suggestion quality. missing for 10: hands-on validation of Agent Mode's insight generation, concrete examples of AI-generated suggestions from collection/analytics data, independent corroboration beyond vendor docs.
